description: Brainbase MCP lets users create, inspect, update, test, deploy, and monitor managed AI agents from ChatGPT and Codex. It supports revision-safe agent changes, registry skills and MCP server configuration, evaluations, orchestrations, schedules, and task runs, with explicit confirmation for destructive actions and OAuth-based access to the user's Brainbase workspace.

defaultPrompt: Audit my Brainbase agents and flag outdated instructions, missing skills, or risky tool access

Find my recent failed agent tasks, explain what went wrong, and recommend the smallest fix
